title: SubTitles Bar - displays a separate window displaying the Ship AI last spoken sentence.
Show SubTitles bar
desc: If ON will show the SubTitles bar

title: SubTitles bar transparency
desc: Set level of transparency from 100 (semi-invisible) to 255 (opaque). Tip: Leave this at 255 if you plan to make the background translucent

title: SubTitles bar Translucency
desc: Set this ON to make the subtitles bar background translucent. Note: Turn this OFF temporarily if you want to move the window.

title: SubTitles bar Scalar
desc: Scales the size of the Mini-Bar (range = 0.5 to 4).

title: SubTitles bar width
desc: Set your preferred width. Note, note too thin, else long sentences will scroll off end. Note: height is fixed to 3 lines in depth.

title: Minimum time to display new text (Normal mode)
desc: The minimum amount of time in seconds to display new captions before clearing. If 0, captions will never clear.

title: Minimum time to display new text (Time Trial mode)
desc: The minimum amount of time in seconds to display new captions before clearing, while in a Time Trial If 0, captions will never clear.

title: Caption display time per word displayed (seconds)
desc: This will calculate an elapsed time to display the last caption, based on number of words. Will not be less than minimum time as set above.
